title: Primary-Standby Recovery Rehearsal Framework & Backup Integrity Validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines a reproducible Recovery Rehearsal Framework for the Primary-Standby (active/standby) topology, plus a comprehensive backup integrity validation process and scheduled failover drills. Goal: give SREs and platform owners an automated, low-friction way to rehearse region swaps, validate backups/restores, and exercise circuit breaker and load-shedding behavior under controlled conditions without impacting paid customers.

Why now:
- Recent incidents highlighted gaps in deterministic rollback criteria and partial KV/cache corruption handling.
- We want measurable SLO proof-points for multi-region failovers (RPO/RTO, P99 tail latency during switchover).
- Build confidence for Dedicated/Private customers that we can meet contract SLAs during regional degradations.

Scope and deliverables (this ticket):
1) Recovery Rehearsal Framework (RRF):
   - A set of orchestrated scenarios (automated via scripts/orchestrator) to perform: graceful primary drainage, promote standby, DNS/route cutover, prefix/KV cache warmup, and rollback.
   - Drill modes: dry-run (no client traffic), shadow-traffic (mirrored requests), limited-traffic (1-5% real traffic), full-cutover (controlled).
   - Orchestration primitives: preflight checks, canary probes, circuit breaker injection points, and automated rollback triggers.

2) Backup & Restore Integrity Validation (BRIV):
   - Automated backup verification: checksum, schema snapshot, sample restore to ephemeral cluster, and read-consistency checks against golden queries.
   - Restore harness name: restore_harness_v2 (scripts/restore/restore_harness_v2.sh).
   - Periodic test matrix: weekly full snapshot restore (staging), daily incremental check (staging), monthly cross-region restore.

3) Circuit Breaker and Load-Shedding Exercise Plan:
   - Controlled stress tests that verify CB thresholds and load-shedding policies when standby promoted or when route capacity is constrained.
   - Test harness will sweep thresholds: error_count window, latency window, and backoff durations.

4) Metrics & Acceptance Criteria: see Acceptance Criteria field.

Operational runbook (condensed):
- Preflight (~1h): validate backups (BRIV), confirm infra quotas in target region, run smoke tests against standby endpoints.
- Lockdown (15m): set service to maintenance channel for non-critical tenants, set traffic throttle to 2% (limited-traffic) if not running a shadow run.
- Drain primary (10-30m): wait for inflight KV writes to flush; monitor write quorum consistency and cache eviction rates.
- Promote standby (5-10m): flip leader flag, promote DB replica, update routing.
- Verify (15-45m): run golden query suite, check P50/P95/P99 latency, error rates, and token throughput.
- Rollback criteria: any data-loss signal, >3% sustained error rate increase that cannot be resolved in 15m, or unresolved KV divergence.
- Post-mortem / learning tasks: collect logs, assess CB triggers, tune thresholds, and update runbook.

Automation & artifacts (links):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RR/Primary+Standby+Recovery+Rehearsal
- Orchestrator repo (scripts): https://github.com/redwood-inference/drill-orchestrator (PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/drill-orchestrator/pull/72)
- Restore harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-scripts/pull/319
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/DR/recovery-rehearsal-overview

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not change production routing policies permanently; all changes must be revertible via the orchestrator.
- It does not include full enterprise runbook translation for customer ops teams (separate follow-on).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: accidental route leak exposing maintenance state. Mitigation: preflight includes a network isolation verification step and a canary umbrella.
- Risk: incomplete backup validation. Mitigation: require checksums + sample restore + golden query pass before allowing promotion.
- Risk: cascading load-shedding across multiple services. Mitigation: staggered promotion with traffic shaping and CB circuit warmup windows.

Success metrics (post-drill):
- RTO measured < 5 minutes for control plane steps (DNS, leader flag) and < 15 minutes end-to-end for application readiness in limited-traffic mode.
- No customer-facing errors above baseline for limited-traffic runs.
- BRIV: 100% verification pass for weekly snapshots in staging.
- Circuit breaker: triggers at expected thresholds and recovers per policy without manual intervention.

Next steps (implementation plan):
- M1 (2w): implement preflight checks + BRIV scripts + restore_harness_v2.
- M2 (2w): extend drill-orchestrator with canary probes and traffic modes.
- M3 (1w): wire dashboards and automated evidence collection.
- M4 (1w): run first internal limited-traffic drill, capture metrics, and schedule retro.
